```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(melidosData)
source("../project_globals.R")
source("mpi_trial_times.R")

```

```{r}
path_study_dates <- paste0("../data/Study_dates_MeLiDos_", site, ".xlsx")

#import table with study times
Study_dates <- read_mpi_study_dates(
  path_study_dates,
  corrections = "../data/corrections/trial_ids.csv",
  audit_path = "../output/data_quality/trial_id_corrections.csv"
)
stopifnot(
  "MPI trial IDs must use the MPI_S participant prefix" =
    all(grepl("^MPI_S[0-9]{3}$", Study_dates$subjectID_device)),
  "MPI trial IDs must be unique" = !anyDuplicated(Study_dates$subjectID_device)
)
#gather the important information
Study_dates <-
  Study_dates |> 
    rename(Id = subjectID_device, start = datetime_trial_start, end = datetime_trial_end) |> 
    select(Id, start, end) |> 
    mutate(across(c(start, end), \(x) force_tz(x, melidos_tzs[site])),
           trial = TRUE) |> 
  group_by(Id)
```

## Exporting values

```{r}
trial_times <- Study_dates
save(trial_times, file = "../data/imported/trial_times.RData")
```
